import sys, importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("cs", sys.argv[3] if len(sys.argv)>3 else "cases.py")
# just re-read the CASES literal by exec'ing the header-free part
src = open(sys.argv[3] if len(sys.argv)>3 else "cases.py").read()
start = src.index("CASES = [")
end = src.index("\n]\n", start)
CASES = eval(src[start+len("CASES = "):end+2])
a = [l.rstrip("\n") for l in open(sys.argv[1])]
b = [l.rstrip("\n") for l in open(sys.argv[2])]
mismatch = []
unsup = 0
errboth = 0
same = 0
for i, (x, y) in enumerate(zip(a, b)):
    xi, _, xv = x.partition("|")
    yi, _, yv = y.partition("|")
    assert xi == yi == str(i), (x, y)
    if yv == "UNSUP":
        unsup += 1; continue
    if xv.startswith("ERR:") and yv.startswith("ERR:"):
        errboth += 1; continue
    if xv == yv:
        same += 1; continue
    mismatch.append((i, CASES[i], xv, yv))
print("total", len(a), "same", same, "unsupported", unsup, "both-error", errboth, "MISMATCH", len(mismatch))
seen = set()
for i, c, x, y in mismatch:
    key = (c[0], c[3])
    print("  #%d op=%s flags=%d pat=%r subj=%r\n      cpython=%s\n      pygram =%s" % (i, c[0], c[3], c[1], c[2], x, y))

import random, sys, gen

rnd = random.Random(int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 7)
N = int(sys.argv[1])

ATOM = ["a", "b", "1", "_", ".", "x", "\\d", "\\w", "\\s", "\\S", "\\D",
        "[ab]", "[^ab]", "[a-z]", "[\\w]", "[\\w.]", "[#a]", "[ ]", "[]a]",
        "(a)", "(?:ab)", "(a|b)", "(?P<n>a)", "\\.", "\\ ", "\\#", "-", ","]
QUANT = ["", "", "", "*", "+", "?", "{2}", "{1,2}", "{2,}", "{0,1}", "*?", "+?"]
SEP = ["", "", " ", "  ", "\n", "\t", " # c\n", "# c\n", " #c", "\n  ", " # a b\n ", "|"]
SUBJ = ["", "a", "ab", "aab", "abc", "a b", "a#b", "a\nb", "1a_", "a,b",
        "räksmörgås abc", "café x", "a—b", "a b",
        "€5 1·4", "aaa bbb", "AB ab", "x{2,3}", "  ", "a.b", "AÅB"]
FLAGS = [64, 64, 64, 256, 256, 64 | 256, 64 | 2, 256 | 2, 64 | 8, 64 | 16, 256 | 16, 64 | 256 | 2]
OPS = ["findall", "sub", "split", "search", "fullmatch", "subx", "finditer"]

cases = []
for _ in range(N):
    k = rnd.randint(1, 4)
    pat = ""
    for j in range(k):
        pat += rnd.choice(SEP) + rnd.choice(ATOM) + rnd.choice(QUANT)
    pat += rnd.choice(SEP)
    cases.append((rnd.choice(OPS), pat, rnd.choice(SUBJ), rnd.choice(FLAGS)))
gen.emit(cases, sys.argv[3] if len(sys.argv) > 3 else "cases.py")
print(len(cases))
